messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

That order's complete, John. The NerdQaxe++ shipped July 7 and was delivered July 13: (tracking link hidden)

Nothing else is pending on it. What's still open is the warranty on that unit, and you're right that no email reached you. I'm putting the fault in front of our tech now so you get a real verdict rather than another promise.

One thing that helps him: has the unit changed at all since the fuse swap, or is it still LCD on USB-C with the fans twitching?
I filled out the RSA. I have received no response
I tried various power supplies.  Still just the twitching fans.  I pluged the LCD into a USB-C and it powers on.  It says there is some power fault

Back with you on the order side, John. That answers it: different supplies, same twitching fans and a power fault on the screen. That's the board, not the power.

Hal has validated it as defective under warranty, and the return on Shop···· is with the team for final approval. They confirm by email shortly, with the next step for sending it back.

Nothing more for you to do tonight. Keep the unit and its box as they are, and don't open it further.
it has been a couple weeks already.  Are you sure this has been logged correctly?

Fair question after two weeks of nothing, and I don't blame you for asking.

Yes, it's on the order now, not sitting in a form. Shop····, NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1, blown fuse replaced like for like, stock clocks, multiple supplies tried, fans twitch and the screen reports a power fault. Hal's verdict on it is defective under warranty.

What's left is the approval, which goes to the team at 10am ET tomorrow, and you get the email with how to send it back.
